user.title: Pool Pump Scheduler
user.description: Configure your pool pump scheduling. The integration picks the cheapest electricity hours each day while respecting a minimum continuous run length, so your pump doesn't cycle on and off too rapidly.

data.name: Name
data.recalc_time: Daily recalculation time (after tomorrow's prices are published)
data.use_max_price: Skip hours above a price ceiling
data.max_price: Maximum price (only used if ceiling is enabled)
data.use_solar_surplus: Run from solar surplus when available
data.pump_power_w: Pump power draw (W) — the surplus threshold
data.inverter_power_sensor: Secondary load power sensor (W, optional) — e.g. pool heat-pump inverter, folded into cost

error.runtime_must_be_positive: Runtime must be greater than zero.
error.min_block_too_small: Minimum block length must be at least 15 minutes.
error.solar_sensor_required: Both solar production and consumption sensors must be set when solar surplus is enabled.

abort.already_configured: This pump switch is already configured.
